Path 2, ClaudeGOALS §3.2

Claude Agent SDK and Managed Agents

Two ways to get a full agent loop without writing one, differing in who hosts it.

WHAT IT IS

The Agent SDK packages the Claude Code harness as a library: built-in tools, hooks, subagents and permissions, running on our infrastructure. Managed Agents is Anthropic-hosted, with the loop and a per-session sandbox on Anthropic's side.

WHAT SETS IT APART

Agent SDK: our pods, our identity, our egress policy, so it can reach inside our network. Managed Agents: nothing to host, but its sandbox isn't inside our network. ⚠️ Check Bedrock availability.

WHERE WE STAND

Trial the Agent SDK for agents that run as cluster workloads. Keep Managed Agents for self-contained work only.
